data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs showcasing various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard includes a line chart for LLM cost over time.
Dashboard includes a bar chart for stage completion rates.
Dashboard includes an area chart for success rate trends.

features.title: Chart.js Pipeline Visualization
features.description: Implement an 8-stage pipeline visualization using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: The pipeline is represented using a Chart.js visualization.
Each stage is clearly labeled and distinct.
The visualization accurately reflects the pipeline stages.

features.title: HTML Presentation with Embedded Resources
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for visualization.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included and functional within the HTML.

features.title: Display Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Showcase actual data from recent runs within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are displayed accurately in the presentation.
Data is up-to-date and relevant.
Metrics are integrated into the appropriate charts.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics Visualization
features.description: Visualize code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: A radar chart is used to display code quality metrics.
Metrics include TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
The chart is clear and easy to interpret.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality and navigation controls for slides.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance at a set interval.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Interactive Chart.js Animations
features.description: Enhance visualizations with interactive Chart.js animations.
acceptance_criteria: Charts include animations that enhance user engagement.
Animations are smooth and do not hinder performance.
Users can interact with charts to gain more insights.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: A pie chart is used to represent supervisor integration.
Each segment of the pie chart is clearly labeled.
The chart accurately reflects integration data.

features.title: Professional Presentation Design
features.description: Design a professional presentation with gradient backgrounds and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: The presentation includes a professional gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth and visually appealing.
The design is consistent with professional standards.
